description: Every technology Jonas has used since 1990, from the technology timeline on jsplinter.nl: each row with its slug, name, kind, topic group, start and end (to = null: still in use), tag, a short note, what replaced it (a slug) and its URL on /timeline/. Newest start first. Optional filters: query, group, in_use. Without filters the turning points (the key moments) come too. The same data as JSON: https://jsplinter.nl/myapi/timeline.php

group.description: Optional topic group, as on the filter buttons of /timeline/: systems, internet, network, gaming, storage, voice, chat, calls, social, phones, navigation, web, cloud, automation, home, analytics, work, tools, ai.

in_use.description: Optional: true = only what is still in use, false = only what was phased out.

query.description: Optional text to find in the name, kind or note (part of a word is enough, case does not matter), e.g. "linux". Max 120 characters.

name: timeline
title: Technology timeline
